title: Release manifest
description: One release (changes/releases/<version>.json): which fragments it contains, in display order, with the hash of each as released. Written by `python scripts/release.py prepare`; released text is changed only with `python scripts/release.py correct`. See docs/release-architecture.md.

version.description: X.Y.Z, or a pre-release X.Y.Z-rc.N / X.Y.ZaN / X.Y.ZbN. Equals the file name.

title.description: The short name of the release, shown in the collapsed timeline. English is required.

intro.description: Optional Markdown paragraph(s), English: what the release is about.

known_limits.description: Optional Markdown, English, one item each.

fragments.description: The release's changes, in display order inside each type, each with the sha256 of its file as released (CRLF read as LF).

corrections.description: Changes to released text, oldest first. The latest correction of a fragment holds its current hash.
